message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"The evaluated points show a clear precision/area tradeoff: phase_bits=16 gives the best SQNR (82.1 dB) but the largest area (1584.6 um^2), while phase_bits=10 is much smaller (1087.7 um^2) but has poor SQNR (49.0 dB). The current best-balanced point is phase_bits=14 (72.8 dB, 1346.5 um^2), and the prior step already tried decreasing precision from that region. Since increase_precision has no legal unvisited neighbor and increase_table_capacity is also exhausted, decreasing precision is the only available action that can reduce mapped area while remaining in a legal neighboring configuration. This is preferable to switching architecture or interpolation, which would change the design structure more drastically and may not preserve the favorable LUT/linear interpolation behavior."}
